items.summary: Jev use cases for AI agents: Jev AI from TypeSafe AI picks decisions instead of writing like an LLM. Sponsored by Zapier! Zapier SDK levels you up, letting you build custom, code-based automations directly in your editor. Start building with Zapier SDK today: https://bit.ly/4AqADNm We tested Jev inside our own coding workflow and found seven places where it makes your agent faster and cheaper to run. Community with All Resources: https://ailabspro.io/?v=2nc_QMuNp18 The Roundup, our daily newsletter covering the AI stories that matter. Join now: https://www.theroundup.so/ Fast Jev Compaction plugin: https://github.com/tamaratran/fast-jev-compaction What Jev AI is - Jev is an AI model made by TypeSafe. It doesn't write answers out in text like Claude AI or GPT. It picks from a set of options: a yes or no, a list to choose from, or a score. - Along with every pick it gives you a confidence value, a number that shows how sure it was. - Each decision takes a fraction of a second, and you only pay for what you send. The answer it sends back is free. - Jev can't write code or use tools, so it doesn't replace the model in Claude Code. It sits inside Claude Code as the decision maker. How to setup Claude Code with Jev - New signups on TypeSafe's own platform are paused, but Jev is also on OpenRouter and Vercel AI Gateway. We used Vercel AI Gateway. - Create a key on the API Keys page inside AI Gateway and copy it right away, because Vercel only shows it once. - Save it with the…

items.title: Jev Can SERIOUSLY Supercharge Your AI Second Brain (Here's How)
items.summary: My AI second brain makes thousands of decisions every day. Which emails are safe, which ones need a reply, which news is worth my time, which ideas I've already seen. And now Jev makes most of them, way faster and cheaper than an LLM ever could! I show you exactly how it works inside my second brain, including the places Jev still falls short. If you're building your own second brain or any agent that runs on its own, the same pattern works for you too. ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ - OpenRouter, one API for Jev and every LLM in my second brain: https://openrouter.plug.dev/3TJkazW This video is sponsored by OpenRouter. items.title: The Biggest AI Coding Agent Upgrade Is Already on Your Machine?!
items.summary: Every conversation you have with your coding agent is saved as a file on your machine - every prompt, every tool call, every failure. It's a goldmine of data that almost nobody takes advantage of, and it's the best way I've found to make my coding agent better over time. So in this video I show you two ways to use it! The simple way is one prompt that has your coding agent go through your past conversations and suggest the top improvements for your rules, hooks, and skills. The full way puts everything into structured tables in a database (I use Databricks), so you can easily query it with your coding agent and MCP. It's super token efficient too! I also show you the real changes I made to my own AI layer from it (I'm actually keeping every one of them). ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ - Check out Databricks Free Edition - free to use, no credit card, and everything in this video runs on it: https://databricks.plug.dev/xLkLORm Thanks to Databricks for working with me on this video! Btw - the "not used to train" commitment I show ~10 minutes in is from Databricks' paid terms. Free Edition has its own terms that let Databricks use what you upload to improve their services and AI models, so scrub anything sensitive first (or have your coding agent do it like I talk about!). ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ - Join Dynamous for the new Agentic Coding Course 2.0 - the core of the course is now COMPLETE: https://dynamous.ai - The opportunity-scan skill, the simple one-prompt version…
